The FAA was trying to modernize its air-traffic-control network from copper to fiber-optic wires when the situation went so awry that planes were grounded […]

news.title: Marvell’s Trillion-Dollar Target
news.summary: Custom silicon company Marvell wants to acquire Lumentum at $115 billion, dwarfing many previous deals in the publicly traded tech space.
news.title_zh: 邁威爾的兆美元目標
news.summary_zh: 客製化矽晶片公司邁威爾擬以 $115 billion 收購 Lumentum，規模遠超公開交易科技領域許多先前交易。

news.title: Marvell CEO Defends $115 Billion Lumentum Deal: “Sometimes Being Unorthodox” Pays Off
news.summary: Key TakeawaysMarvell agreed on November 2 to buy Lumentum in an all-stock deal valuing it at $115 billion, leaving Lumentum holders with about a third of the combined company. Marvell’s CEO admitted on Fox Business that the deal carries more risk, saying being unorthodox is how you get “the outsized return.
news.title_zh: Marvell CEO 為 $115 Billion Lumentum 交易辯護：「有時非正統」能獲利
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要 Marvell 於 November 2 同意以全股票交易收購 Lumentum，估值 $115 billion，使 Lumentum 股東持有合併公司約三分之一。Marvell CEO 在 Fox Business 承認交易風險較高，稱非正統才能獲得「超額回報」。

news.title: Credo Technology Group vs. Marvell Technology: Which Technology Stock Is a Better Buy for 2027?
news.summary: Credo's revenue surged past 160% in the latest twelve months, but Marvell's $9.5 billion scale and heavier debt load tell a very different story for investors.
news.title_zh: Credo Technology Group 對比 Marvell Technology：哪檔科技股是 2027 較佳買進選擇？
news.summary_zh: Credo 營收在最近十二個月衝破 160%，但 Marvell 的 $9.5 billion 規模與更重債務負擔，對投資人講述截然不同的故事。

news.title: Credo Technology Is Down 57% From Its June High: Dead Money, or Due for a Bounce?
news.summary: Key TakeawaysCredo Technology is down 57% from its June high, a bit more than Astera Labs or Marvell, even though its first-quarter revenue rose 115% to $479 million. MaxLinear wants 20% to 30% of the next generation of active electrical cables, the product behind most of Credo’s growth.
news.title_zh: Credo Technology 股價較六月高點下跌 57%：死錢，還是反彈在即？
news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點Credo Technology 股價較六月高點下跌 57%，跌幅略大於 Astera Labs 或邁威爾，儘管其第一季營收成長 115% 達 $479 million。MaxLinear 欲佔下一代有源電纜 20% to 30%，該產品為 Credo 成長主要動能。

news.title: AMD Sinks 9%, Marvell Down 5% as Chip Rally Reverses and Treasury Yields Hit 5%
news.summary: Key TakeawaysAMD fell 9% today, giving back part of this week’s roughly 30% gain after Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned. That gain came from Nvidia’s turmoil, and fast money leaves fast.
news.title_zh: AMD 下跌 9%，Marvell 下跌 5%，晶片反彈逆轉，美債殖利率觸及 5%
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要 AMD 今日下跌 9%，吐回本週約 30% 漲幅的一部分，此前 Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang 辭職。該漲幅源於 Nvidia 的動盪，熱錢來得快去得也快。

news.title: Marvell Is Still Up 81% This Year. Can MRVL Stock Hit $300 by 2029?
news.summary: A hard autumn for chip stocks hasn’t erased one of the sector’s standout gains of the year. Marvell Technology (NASDAQ:MRVL) stock is up 81% year to date (YTD) to $153.93 in afternoon trading. That price includes a 6% drop from the prior close, as a broad semiconductor selloff hits Marvell and its peers. Technology is […]
news.title_zh: Marvell 今年仍上漲 81%。MRVL 股票能在 2029 前達到 $300 嗎？
news.summary_zh: 晶片股的艱難秋季並未抹去該板塊今年最突出的漲幅之一。Marvell Technology (NASDAQ:MRVL) 股價今年迄今 (YTD) 上漲 81%，至下午交易時段的 $153.93。該價格包含較前收盤價下跌 6%，因廣泛的半導體拋售衝擊 Marvell 及其同業。科技股 […]

news.title: Marvell Stock Could Have a Bigger AI Opportunity Than Investors Realize
news.summary: Marvell's shares have lost nearly 40% in a month, yet its business is accelerating and a quiet Google deal could rewrite the numbers. So why is the market running the other way, and who is about to be proven wrong?
news.title_zh: Marvell 股票可能擁有比投資人認知更大的 AI 機會
news.summary_zh: Marvell 股價在一個月內下跌近 40%，但其業務正在加速，且一項低調的 Google 交易可能重寫數字。那麼為何市場卻朝相反方向運作，誰即將被證明錯誤？

news.title: Lumentum Is Up 56% in 2026, but Marvell Now Sets Its Price. Take Profits, or Buy More?
news.summary: Key TakeawaysLumentum stock is up 56% in 2026, well ahead of rival Coherent, but it’s nearly half off its October high after Marvell’s all-stock deal and an AI chip selloff. Lumentum’s business drove the run: September-quarter revenue rose 136.
news.title_zh: Lumentum 在 2026 上漲 56%，但 Marvell 現在決定其價格。獲利了結，還是加碼買入？
news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點Lumentum 股價在 2026 上漲 56%，遠超競爭對手 Coherent，但在 Marvell 的全股票交易和 AI 晶片拋售潮後，股價較十月高點已近乎腰斬。Lumentum 的業務推動了漲勢：九月季營收上升 136。

news.title: Marvell Soars 23%, Lumentum Up 23% in a Week. Jim Cramer Says It’s Not “a Broken Stock”
news.summary: Key TakeawaysMarvell Technology stock soared 23% in a week, and Lumentum, which Marvell agreed to buy, rose almost as much. CoreWeave’s beat-and-raise revived the AI trade, though Lumentum still trades below the deal’s value.
news.title_zh: Marvell 飆升 23%，Lumentum 一週上漲 23%。Jim Cramer 表示這不是「一檔破股」
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Marvell Technology 股價一週飆升 23%，而 Marvell 同意收購的 Lumentum 漲幅幾乎持平。CoreWeave 的超預期表現與上調展望重燃 AI 題材，儘管 Lumentum 仍低於交易估值交易。

news.title: Lumentum Trades Below Marvell’s Buyout Offer. Is the Gap a Bargain?
news.summary: Lumentum's revenue is more than doubling, yet its stock now moves with Marvell's shares and a regulatory clock that runs into 2028. Who actually profits from the discount, and what could erase it?
news.title_zh: Lumentum 股價低於 Marvell 收購要價。這個缺口是便宜貨嗎？
news.summary_zh: Lumentum 營收翻倍以上，但其股價現在隨 Marvell 股價和監管時限移動，時限延至 2028。誰真正從折價中獲利？什麼可能抹平這個折價？

news.title: Michael Burry Buys More Of Adobe And MercadoLibre, Exits ORCL, CAT Puts
news.summary: Burry continues to hold a large put position in the VanEck Semiconductor ETF, along with puts on the Nasdaq 100, Nvidia, MetLife, and Palantir.

news.summary_zh: Burry 繼續持有 VanEck 半導體 ETF 的大量看跌期權部位，以及 Nasdaq 100、Nvidia、MetLife 和 Palantir 的看跌期權。

news.title: Larry Ellison Has Lost $145 Billion in Net Worth Over the Past Year as Oracle Stock Fell 59% From Its Peak. Here's Why Oracle's Heavy Concentration in OpenAI Has Wall Street Nervous.
news.summary: Oracle is estimated to have over $300 billion in orders from OpenAI, and Wall Street thinks that could be a bad thing.
news.title_zh: Larry Ellison 過去一年因 Oracle 股價從高點下跌 59% 而損失淨值 $145 Billion。這裡解釋為何 Oracle 高度集中於 OpenAI 讓華爾街感到緊張。
news.summary_zh: 據估計 Oracle 從 OpenAI 獲得超過 $300 billion 的訂單，華爾街認為這可能是壞事。

news.title: Micheal Burry’s Massive Bets Against Palantir and Oracle Highlight Two Prominent AI Failure Modalities
news.summary: Two AI darlings beat earnings, yet Michael Burry is betting against both. One stock is priced for perfection, the other is burning cash to build its future. Which kind of risk would you rather own?
news.title_zh: Michael Burry 大舉做空 Palantir 和 Oracle，凸顯兩種顯著的 AI 失敗模式
news.summary_zh: 兩檔 AI 寵兒財報超預期，Michael Burry 卻同時做空兩者。一檔股價已定價完美，另一檔為建設未來燒錢。你寧願承擔哪種風險？

news.title: Nvidia’s Interim CEO Pushed Back on a “$250 Billion Credit Backstop” for OpenAI. Oracle Has the Most at Stake
news.summary: Key TakeawaysThe Information reports that Nvidia’s interim CEO, Colette Kress, pushed back on a proposed $250 billion credit backstop for OpenAI while she was finance chief, and that Nvidia is expected to slow its AI investment strategy. Oracle has the most at stake: Steve Eisman puts about half of its $664 billion backlog with OpenAI, and its free cash flow was negative $23.
news.title_zh: Nvidia 臨時執行長反對為 OpenAI 提供「$250 Billion 信用擔保」。Oracle 風險最大
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要The Information 報導，Nvidia 臨時執行長 Colette Kress 在擔任財務長時，反對提議的 $250 billion 信用擔保給 OpenAI，且預期 Nvidia 將放緩其 AI 投資策略。Oracle 風險最大：Steve Eisman 指出其約一半的 $664 billion 積壓訂單來自 OpenAI，且其自由現金流為負 $23。

news.title: CoreWeave Jumped 20% and Pulled Oracle Higher. Is It Time to Sell, or Load Up?
news.summary: Key TakeawaysOracle sold $20 billion of stock and bonds days after capping new capital-market funding at that amount through fiscal 2030. Bloomberg reported that Microsoft is winding down a 2023 deal to rent AI computing from Oracle on older Nvidia chips.
news.title_zh: CoreWeave 飆升 20% 並帶動 Oracle 上漲。是時候賣出，還是加碼？
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Oracle 在將新資本市場融資上限設定為該金額至財政年度 2030 後幾天，售出了 $20 billion 的股票和債券。彭博社報導，微軟正在逐步終止一項 2023 協議，該協議旨在從 Oracle 租用基於較舊 Nvidia 晶片的 AI 運算。

news.title: Bloom Energy Soars 13%, Vertiv Up 14% in a Week as Data-Center Fears Ease
news.summary: Key TakeawaysBloom Energy rose 13% in the past week, with Vertiv and Oracle, after CoreWeave and Constellation Energy raised their 2026 guidance. Bloom had no news of its own, and with its orders and rising estimates intact, the bounce looks like it has further to go.
news.title_zh: Bloom Energy 飆升 13%，Vertiv 上漲 14%，一週內數據中心憂慮緩解
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Bloom Energy 過去一週上漲 13%，連同 Vertiv 和 Oracle，在 CoreWeave 和 Constellation Energy 上調其 2026 展望後。Bloom 本身無消息，且其訂單與上調估計保持完好，反彈似乎還有空間。

news.title: Forget Nvidia: Curbs on China’s Remote Chip Access Are a “Nightmare Scenario” for Oracle
news.summary: Key TakeawaysThe U. S. is reportedly finalizing a rule to stop Chinese firms renting AI chips abroad.
news.title_zh: 別再盯著輝達：限制中國遠端存取晶片對甲骨文是「噩夢場景」
news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點：據報導，美國正在敲定一項規則，禁止中國企業在海外租用AI晶片。

news.title: Microsoft Just Piled Onto the Bad News for CoreWeave, Oracle, and Nebius
news.summary: Microsoft's latest move could completely change the outlook for some neocloud companies.
news.title_zh: 微軟剛為 CoreWeave、Oracle 和 Nebius 增添壞消息
news.summary_zh: 微軟的最新舉措可能完全改變部分新雲端公司的前景。

news.title: Oracle Now Gets “$16 Billion a Year” per Gigawatt, Up From $10 Billion
news.summary: Key TakeawaysOracle says a gigawatt on new AI contracts now brings in $16 billion a year at full ramp, up 60% from $10 billion in October 2025. CFO Hilary Maxson says it’s mainly memory costs passed through cost-plus contracts, so each gigawatt costs more too.
news.title_zh: Oracle 現在每吉瓦每年獲得「$16 Billion」，高於 $10 Billion
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Oracle 表示，新 AI 合約的每吉瓦在全面達產時每年帶來 $16 billion，較 October 2025 的 $10 billion 增加 60%。CFO Hilary Maxson 指出，這主要是透過成本加成合約轉嫁的記憶體成本，因此每吉瓦成本也更高。

news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Applied Digital 於過去一週上漲 20%，因 AI 資料中心股票在 IREN 和 CoreWeave 的業績帶動下反彈。CoreWeave 上調展望使其與 Applied Digital 的 $11 billion 租約顯得更安全。

news.title: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO amid scandal
news.summary: Nvidia co-founder Jensen Huang has resigned as CEO effective immediately, sending shares down as much as 14% and dragging bitcoin miners-turned-AI data center firms Cipher, IREN, and Terawulf down 5% to 10%. CoinDesk’s Uyen Truong hosts “CoinDesk Daily.”

news.summary_zh: Nvidia聯席創辦人黃仁勳已立即生效辭去CEO職務，導致股價下跌高達 14%，並拖累轉型為AI數據中心公司的比特幣礦企Cipher、IREN和Terawulf下跌 5% to 10%。CoinDesk的Uyen Truong主持「CoinDesk Daily」節目。
